# Steam

2 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/steam/app - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Steam store app (a game, DLC, software or soundtrack) by its numeric app id: name, short description, store link, header image and screenshots, current price in the store's currency with the pre-discount price when on sale, availability (Available or Coming soon) and Steam's feature categories (`product.features`, for example Single-player or Steam Achievements). `product.brand` is the first developer. `product.ext.steam` adds the type, developers, publishers, genres, release date as Steam shows it, age rating, supported platforms, Metacritic score and link, the recommendation count, the achievement count, the website, the supported languages and the full description as plain text. A free app has a current price of 0. An app id Steam does not know answers 404 and is not charged.

**Use when** Use it with an app id when you track a game's price, reception or store page over time.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `app_id` (required) - Numeric Steam app id, the number in a store link: store.steampowered.com/app/620/ is 620. · e.g. `620`
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country code that sets the store, the currency and what is on sale, for example US (default), GB or DE.
- `language` (optional, string) - Steam language name for the text, for example english (default), german, french, spanish or schinese.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+6 more (types in the full schema): `product` {features, image_urls}; `product.ext` {steam}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}. Never filled: `product.rating.average`, `product.rating.count`, `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/steam/app" \
  --data-urlencode "app_id=620" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/steam/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns up to 10 Steam store matches for a game or software title, ranked by Steam: the app id (`product.id`, the id GET /v1/steam/app takes), name, store link, capsule image and price in the store's currency, with the pre-discount price when the item is on sale. `product.ext.steam` adds the item type, Metacritic score, supported platforms and controller support where Steam shows them. A search with no matches returns an empty list. Free items and items without a store price have a null price.

**Use when** you want to find a game's app id before calling steam/app, or to compare prices across a few titles.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** single page - Steam's store search answers one ranked set of up to 10 matches with no further page; refine the query for other titles.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Game or software title, 1 to 200 characters, for example portal. · e.g. `portal`
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country code that sets the store, the currency and what is on sale, for example US (default), GB or DE.
- `language` (optional, string) - Steam language name for the text, for example english (default), german, french, spanish or schinese.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.ext.steam` | Steam store detail. |
| `product.price.currency` | Currency code of the price. |

+2 more (types in the full schema): `product.price` {current, original}. Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.description`, `product.rating.average`, `product.rating.count`, `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/steam/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=portal" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
